'''J. K. Burtola''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who joined the [[Jedi Order]] at a young age and as a [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi youngling]] trained as a member of [[Bear Clan]]. In [[22 BBY]], he and his clanmates received [[lightsaber]] training from [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. The lesson was interrupted by [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who sought Yoda's help in locating the [[planet]] [[Kamino]]. The Grand Master opened up the question of why the planet might be missing from the [[Jedi Archives]] to the class, and Burtola correctly guessed that someone erased it.

==Biography==
J. K. Burtola was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="AOTC" /> who was born at some point between [[30 BBY]] and [[26 BBY]].<ref name="Birth Date" /> As a young child he became a member of the [[Jedi Order]]'s [[Bear Clan]]<ref name="DB Bear" /> of [[Jedi Initiate|younglings]] and trained in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="AOTC" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which includes Burtola's appearance, to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Burtola and the rest of the Bear Clan were practicing with [[training lightsaber]]s under the tutelage of [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] in one of the temple's classrooms when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] interrupted the lesson to seek Yoda's guidance.<ref name="AOTC" />

Yoda halted the class, and Burtola and the others greeted Kenobi, who explained that he was looking for the [[planet]] [[Kamino]], but could not find it in the [[Jedi Archives]]. Yoda asked Burtola's classmate [[Liam]] to lower the classroom's blinds so that Kenobi could show the class a [[Hologram|holographic]] [[star]] map and indicate where the planet should be. The Grand Master then asked the class if they had any thoughts on why the planet might be missing, and Burtola correctly guessed that it had been erased from the archives. Satisfied with this answer, Yoda moved away from the younglings to speak briefly with Kenobi about this troubling idea.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Burtola was [[The Force|Force]]-sensitive and had fair skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Equipment==
Burtola wore brown [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]], a brown [[belt]] and a gray training [[Armor|helmet]] while at the temple and used a practice [[lightsaber]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JKBurtola.jpg|thumb|right|J. K. Burtola was portrayed by Alex Knoll.|200px]]
J. K. Burtola was portrayed by [[Alex Knoll]], son of [[Industrial Light & Magic]] chief creative officer [[John Knoll]], in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and was identified in the film's credits.<ref name="AOTC" /> The character was identified as simply "Jedi Child Jack" in the film's script.<ref name="Old DB">{{DB|organization|bearclan|Bear Clan}}</ref> Author [[Delilah S. Dawson]] later confirmed a youngling, referenced as speaking with a lisp, featured in ''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]'' is<ref name="Burtola tweet 1">{{Twitter|DelilahSDawson|status/1689662615427964929|[[Delilah S. Dawson]]|…it absolutely is! {{C|In response to: "Rise of the Red Blade mentions a youngling at the temple with a lisp and I really want it to be J.K. Burtola 🥹 @DelilahSDawson" }}|archivedate=20231020033214}}</ref> intended to be Burtola.<ref name="Burtola tweet 2">{{Twitter|DelilahSDawson|status/1689663086892855296|[[Delilah S. Dawson]]|*cough*Or at least that's my own headcanon and exactly what I was referencing in that scene.|archivedate=20230822021215}}</ref>
